biggest_catch: Only first-time CEFCU checking accounts qualify, and the $250 credit requires hitting one of four balance/activity thresholds within the first full calendar month after opening — miss that month and the main bonus is gone.
catches: First-time CEFCU checking accounts only; not available on transfers of existing CEFCU checking accounts, and not available to members who have previously had a checking account with CEFCU.
Per the official page, open a new first-time checking account with a deposit of $25 or more between 9/1/26 and 12/31/26 and reside in California.

To receive the $250 savings credit: within the first full calendar month after account opening, satisfy at least ONE of: (a) minimum individual balance of $5,000, (b) minimum household balance of $10,000, (c) 5 or more purchases of at least $15 with the new checking debit card, or (d) direct deposits totaling $500 or more on the new checking or associated savings account.
Also required for the $250 credit: agree to receive CEFCU savings account statements electronically (eStatements) before the end of that first full calendar month.
Account must be maintained in good standing as of the bonus fulfillment date.
The $250 bonus is deposited to the CEFCU savings account associated with the new checking account within 4 to 6 weeks of the end of the first full calendar month after account opening.

To receive the $25 savings credit: use the CEFCU debit card for 5 or more purchases of at least $15 each month, for the first three full calendar months following account opening; paid within 4 to 6 weeks of the end of the third full calendar month.
Must be at least 13 years old and have a valid SSN/ITIN to qualify.
There is a combined limit of $275 for personal checking account-related bonuses per member.
Official terms state the value of the bonuses is considered a taxable dividend and will be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.

steps: Open a new first-time CEFCU checking account between September 1 and December 31, 2026 with a deposit of $25 or more.

Within the first full calendar month after opening, meet ONE of: $5,000+ individual balance, $10,000+ household balance, 5+ debit purchases of $15+, or $500+ in direct deposits — and enroll in eStatements before that month ends.
Use the debit card for 5+ purchases of $15+ in each of the first three full calendar months for the extra $25 credit.
Keep the account open and in good standing; the $250 credit lands 4–6 weeks after the first full month, the $25 credit 4–6 weeks after the third full month.
Expect the bonuses to be reported on IRS Form 1099-INT as taxable dividends.
